@graph.name: TokenHUD
@graph.description: A heads-up display for the AI coding agents running on your machine. Live token metering, estimated spend, and plan-limit windows for Claude Code and Codex CLI — running entirely on your own computer.

offers.name: Solo
offers.description: Free forever for one developer on one machine. Unlimited metering, no sampling, full local history. Runs with the network off.

offers.name: Team
offers.description: Per seat. Cross-machine rollups, shared budgets, retained history, chargeback reports, and alerts to Slack and email. Planned — not yet available.

featureList: Discovers AI coding agents and their sessions on the host with no configuration
Meters token usage and estimated spend by session, agent, model and project
Shows your plan's real five-hour and seven-day usage windows and when they reset
Reports which agents finished while you were away
Never reads prompt text, completion text, or source code
@graph.softwareRequirements: Rust toolchain to build from source. Two static binaries; no interpreter, no package manager.
